comment: The leader of a Tam-Tara Deepcroft room's pack (BNpcBase 82): 516 HP, level 16, standing where it is (it never moved) casting 966 (0.7 s) every 3.1 s; its death calls the room's boss. From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Tam-Tara Deepcroft (2026-10-24): one run with Duty Support (3ec702a8, visit 0.3) and two Duty Finder runs (cc26e0ea, visits 0.2 and 0.4), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
